title: Promote review feedback into a hard invariant with provenance
narrative: Repeated review feedback becomes an experiment, then a soft instruction, then a hard invariant — always with source permalink and rollback evidence. Accepts WalkingLabs L10 and L12 guidance[^wl-l10-promo][^wl-l12-promo]. Soft-to-hard promotion substrate for personal-agent MH-PA-07 (`taloneth_insp_correction_spec_debt`)[^insp-pa-07-promo] and self-revising MH-SR-05 (`fangore_insp_recipe_lineage_promote`)[^insp-sr-05-promo].
implementation: `PromotionRecord`, `promote_soft_to_hard`, and `rollback_promotion` in `mechaharness.rule_promotion` model the promotion chain.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/rule_promotion.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
